passes/13_tripod_theta_tree_backbones/.title: Pass XIII — tripod–theta tree backbones
passes/13_tripod_theta_tree_backbones/.summary: Coherent decycling partitions of cyclically 4-edge-connected cubic graphs: tree-edge congestion, two-connector root-avoiding cycles, theta normal form; rank-two dyadic forcing fails already at orders 10 and 14 (certificates independently verified). Packet with MANIFEST sha256s.

passes/14_rooted_stress_test/.title: Pass XIV — rooted stress test (code, catalogs, results)
passes/14_rooted_stress_test/.summary: C checker and generator: all 3-connected cubic graphs through 16 vertices (counts match OEIS) are root-robust except K4, two 8-vertex graphs and one 16-vertex graph; every known hard instance (4/8/16-free up to 126 vertices, the 370- and 26,550-vertex constructions) is root-robust, with independently verified witnesses.
